meta.title: Upturn
meta.description: Reinforcements appearing in times of crisis is always an encouraging sign.

units.rawText: Helios Sector, Reactor No. 1.
units.displayText: Helios Sector, Reactor No. 1.

spans.text: Helios Sector, Reactor No. 1.

units.rawText: What's wrong, Croque? What do you see?
units.displayText: What's wrong, Croque? What do you see?

spans.text: What's wrong, Croque? What do you see?

units.rawText: God damn, the Professor's right. There's something very wrong with Reactor No. 1.
units.displayText: God damn, the Professor's right. There's something very wrong with Reactor No. 1.

spans.text: God damn, the Professor's right. There's something very wrong with Reactor No. 1.

units.rawText: The core furnace and conduits are overloaded and the external mechanical structure is completely deformed — if I'm not wrong, this place is about to explode!
units.displayText: The core furnace and conduits are overloaded and the external mechanical structure is completely deformed — if I'm not wrong, this place is about to explode!

spans.text: The core furnace and conduits are overloaded and the external mechanical structure is completely deformed — if I'm not wrong, this place is about to explode!

units.rawText: Let's hope you're wrong, then!
units.displayText: Let's hope you're wrong, then!

spans.text: Let's hope you're wrong, then!

units.rawText: Can you fix it, Croque?!
units.displayText: Can you fix it, Croque?!

spans.text: Can you fix it, Croque?!

units.rawText: No can do, the energy leaking out is enough to power several-meter tall bipedal robots through a seaside marathon.
units.displayText: No can do, the energy leaking out is enough to power several-meter tall bipedal robots through a seaside marathon.

spans.text: No can do, the energy leaking out is enough to power several-meter tall bipedal robots through a seaside marathon.

units.rawText: It'd be faster if I just blew this place up directly!
units.displayText: It'd be faster if I just blew this place up directly!

spans.text: It'd be faster if I just blew this place up directly!

units.rawText: Calm down, Croque. You can study it and then solve it next time, right?
units.displayText: Calm down, Croque. You can study it and then solve it next time, right?

spans.text: Calm down, Croque. You can study it and then solve it next time, right?

units.rawText: She won't remember anything next time. We need to solve it right away.
units.displayText: She won't remember anything next time. We need to solve it right away.

spans.text: She won't remember anything next time. We need to solve it right away.

units.rawText: If only we had someone else to help. It's too much to expect Croque to handle this by herself. Where are the other staff for Reactor No. 1?
units.displayText: If only we had someone else to help. It's too much to expect Croque to handle this by herself. Where are the other staff for Reactor No. 1?

spans.text: If only we had someone else to help. It's too much to expect Croque to handle this by herself. Where are the other staff for Reactor No. 1?

units.rawText: I didn't see any other workers, just these mini-robots. Give me that toolbox.
units.displayText: I didn't see any other workers, just these mini-robots. Give me that toolbox.

spans.text: I didn't see any other workers, just these mini-robots. Give me that toolbox.

units.rawText: Ahem. In any case, let's start by taking the protective casing off this tin can.
units.displayText: Ahem. In any case, let's start by taking the protective casing off this tin can.

spans.text: Ahem. In any case, let's start by taking the protective casing off this tin can.

units.rawText: Don't do it, Croque! Think of another solution, don't be in a hurry to blow...
units.displayText: Don't do it, Croque! Think of another solution, don't be in a hurry to blow...

spans.text: Don't do it, Croque! Think of another solution, don't be in a hurry to blow...

units.rawText: You dummy! I'm taking it apart to study it! Persicaria, I need operand support.
units.displayText: You dummy! I'm taking it apart to study it! Persicaria, I need operand support.

spans.text: You dummy! I'm taking it apart to study it! Persicaria, I need operand support.

units.rawText: Yup!
units.displayText: Yup!

spans.text: Yup!

units.rawText: Sol and I step back, watching as Croque and Persicaria work frantically, but we're unable to provide any concrete help.
units.displayText: Sol and I step back, watching as Croque and Persicaria work frantically, but we're unable to provide any concrete help.

spans.text: Sol and I step back, watching as Croque and Persicaria work frantically, but we're unable to provide any concrete help.

units.rawText: Time passes, and the light from the reactor furnace begins growing brighter. Even amateurs like Sol and myself can tell that something is wrong.
units.displayText: Time passes, and the light from the reactor furnace begins growing brighter. Even amateurs like Sol and myself can tell that something is wrong.

spans.text: Time passes, and the light from the reactor furnace begins growing brighter. Even amateurs like Sol and myself can tell that something is wrong.

units.rawText: No good, the problem doesn't seem to be here.
units.displayText: No good, the problem doesn't seem to be here.

spans.text: No good, the problem doesn't seem to be here.

units.rawText: How could this...
units.displayText: How could this...

spans.text: How could this...

units.rawText: There's nothing we can do, Persicaria. We were barking up the wrong tree.
units.displayText: There's nothing we can do, Persicaria. We were barking up the wrong tree.

spans.text: There's nothing we can do, Persicaria. We were barking up the wrong tree.

units.rawText: The problem isn't with the reactor furnace. It's just a link in the chain of reactions.
units.displayText: The problem isn't with the reactor furnace. It's just a link in the chain of reactions.

spans.text: The problem isn't with the reactor furnace. It's just a link in the chain of reactions.

units.rawText:
The light from the reactor furnace grows brighter, and the heat it radiates turns the air scalding hot.
The explosion seems imminent.
units.displayText:
The light from the reactor furnace grows brighter, and the heat it radiates turns the air scalding hot.
The explosion seems imminent.

spans.text:
The light from the reactor furnace grows brighter, and the heat it radiates turns the air scalding hot.
The explosion seems imminent.

units.rawText: Just then, a sudden series of footsteps comes from behind us, followed by a shout.
units.displayText: Just then, a sudden series of footsteps comes from behind us, followed by a shout.

spans.text: Just then, a sudden series of footsteps comes from behind us, followed by a shout.

units.rawText: Persicaria... It really...was you!
units.displayText: Persicaria... It really...was you!

spans.text: Persicaria... It really...was you!

units.rawText: A silhouette runs past us and erects a weighty shield.
units.displayText: A silhouette runs past us and erects a weighty shield.

spans.text: A silhouette runs past us and erects a weighty shield.

units.rawText: Zion? What are you doing here?
units.displayText: Zion? What are you doing here?

spans.text: Zion? What are you doing here?

units.rawText: Zion...has always...been here...
units.displayText: Zion...has always...been here...

spans.text: Zion...has always...been here...

units.rawText: Before we can ask any more questions, the core furnace explodes violently, and the shield which Zion is holding up shudders.
units.displayText: Before we can ask any more questions, the core furnace explodes violently, and the shield which Zion is holding up shudders.

spans.text: Before we can ask any more questions, the core furnace explodes violently, and the shield which Zion is holding up shudders.

units.rawText: Hang in there, Zion! I'll back you up!
units.displayText: Hang in there, Zion! I'll back you up!

spans.text: Hang in there, Zion! I'll back you up!

units.rawText: No need...Zion...can handle...explosions!
units.displayText: No need...Zion...can handle...explosions!

spans.text: No need...Zion...can handle...explosions!

units.rawText: Zion refuses Persicaria's assistance and keeps her barrier up by herself, then takes out several chocolates from her backpack and hands them to us.
units.displayText: Zion refuses Persicaria's assistance and keeps her barrier up by herself, then takes out several chocolates from her backpack and hands them to us.

spans.text: Zion refuses Persicaria's assistance and keeps her barrier up by herself, then takes out several chocolates from her backpack and hands them to us.

units.rawText: Quick...eat...these...
units.displayText: Quick...eat...these...

spans.text: Quick...eat...these...

units.rawText: What are these?
units.displayText: What are these?

spans.text: What are these?

units.rawText: No time...! Eat... quick...!
units.displayText: No time...! Eat... quick...!

spans.text: No time...! Eat... quick...!

units.rawText: We eat the chocolates as Zion directs. After that, the reactor furnace behinds us shines brilliantly.
units.displayText: We eat the chocolates as Zion directs. After that, the reactor furnace behinds us shines brilliantly.

spans.text: We eat the chocolates as Zion directs. After that, the reactor furnace behinds us shines brilliantly.

units.rawText: We can't escape! Here comes the big one!
units.displayText: We can't escape! Here comes the big one!

spans.text: We can't escape! Here comes the big one!

units.rawText: Cracks appear in Zion's barrier, and it looks like it's about to crumble. Persicaria hurriedly reaches out and tries to support it, but Zion grabs her hand to stop her.
units.displayText: Cracks appear in Zion's barrier, and it looks like it's about to crumble. Persicaria hurriedly reaches out and tries to support it, but Zion grabs her hand to stop her.

spans.text: Cracks appear in Zion's barrier, and it looks like it's about to crumble. Persicaria hurriedly reaches out and tries to support it, but Zion grabs her hand to stop her.

units.rawText: Zion?
units.displayText: Zion?

spans.text: Zion?

units.rawText: It'll... be fine... see you later!
units.displayText: It'll... be fine... see you later!

spans.text: It'll... be fine... see you later!

units.rawText: Er... see you... later?
units.displayText: Er... see you... later?

spans.text: Er... see you... later?

units.rawText:
Zion happily bids us farewell.
After that, intense light fills my vision.
units.displayText:
Zion happily bids us farewell.
After that, intense light fills my vision.

spans.text:
Zion happily bids us farewell.
After that, intense light fills my vision.

units.rawText: In that moment, everything within sight suddenly vanishes, and the sound in my ears becomes a monotonous ringing.
units.displayText: In that moment, everything within sight suddenly vanishes, and the sound in my ears becomes a monotonous ringing.

spans.text: In that moment, everything within sight suddenly vanishes, and the sound in my ears becomes a monotonous ringing.

units.rawText: Sequence Number 99858, commencing rectification.
units.displayText: Sequence Number 99858, commencing rectification.

spans.text: Sequence Number 99858, commencing rectification.

units.rawText: This time, I clearly hear a low-pitched voice speak in a broadcast, after which everything fades away.
units.displayText: This time, I clearly hear a low-pitched voice speak in a broadcast, after which everything fades away.

spans.text: This time, I clearly hear a low-pitched voice speak in a broadcast, after which everything fades away.

units.rawText: The light fades, and my vision returns to normal.
units.displayText: The light fades, and my vision returns to normal.

spans.text: The light fades, and my vision returns to normal.

units.rawText: I've returned to the beginning once again.
units.displayText: I've returned to the beginning once again.

spans.text: I've returned to the beginning once again.

units.rawText: In fact, I'd say the chances of the machines here exploding are lower than me pulling an SSR in the...
units.displayText: In fact, I'd say the chances of the machines here exploding are lower than me pulling an SSR in the...

spans.text: In fact, I'd say the chances of the machines here exploding are lower than me pulling an SSR in the...

units.rawText: Quiet!
units.displayText: Quiet!

spans.text: Quiet!

units.rawText: ...I'm sorry.
units.displayText: ...I'm sorry.

spans.text: ...I'm sorry.

units.rawText: Looks like you all understand how I felt just now... Wait a minute.
units.displayText: Looks like you all understand how I felt just now... Wait a minute.

spans.text: Looks like you all understand how I felt just now... Wait a minute.

units.rawText: I remember, Professor. I remember everything.
units.displayText: I remember, Professor. I remember everything.

spans.text: I remember, Professor. I remember everything.

units.rawText: Me too!
units.displayText: Me too!

spans.text: Me too!

units.rawText: Me... too...
units.displayText: Me... too...

spans.text: Me... too...

units.rawText: So everyone's memories weren't reset this time? Could it have been the—
units.displayText: So everyone's memories weren't reset this time? Could it have been the—

spans.text: So everyone's memories weren't reset this time? Could it have been the—

units.rawText: >Call request received, now connecting...
units.displayText: >Call request received, now connecting...

spans.text: >Call request received, now connecting...

units.rawText: Dundun~ Dundundundundun~ Dundun~ Dundundundundun~
units.displayText: Dundun~ Dundundundundun~ Dundun~ Dundundundundun~

spans.text: Dundun~ Dundundundundun~ Dundun~ Dundundundundun~

units.displayText: Hey, that's the OP for "Metal Suit"!

units.displayText: I immediately accept the call.

It... it's from Zion! She wants us to meet in front of Reactor No. 1!
Let's go!

units.displayText: Helios Sector, No. 1 Reactor.

units.rawText: We rush over to Reactor No. 1 again, and this time, Zion explains everything to us.
units.displayText: We rush over to Reactor No. 1 again, and this time, Zion explains everything to us.

spans.text: We rush over to Reactor No. 1 again, and this time, Zion explains everything to us.

units.rawText: So the sector resets after the explosion ends? Why would something like that happen...
units.displayText: So the sector resets after the explosion ends? Why would something like that happen...

spans.text: So the sector resets after the explosion ends? Why would something like that happen...

units.rawText: Helios... experiment... fails... start over...
units.displayText: Helios... experiment... fails... start over...

spans.text: Helios... experiment... fails... start over...

units.rawText: What about memories? Do the agents in the sector lose their memories?
units.displayText: What about memories? Do the agents in the sector lose their memories?

spans.text: What about memories? Do the agents in the sector lose their memories?

units.rawText: Zion saw... agents... they... have... no memories...
units.displayText: Zion saw... agents... they... have... no memories...

spans.text: Zion saw... agents... they... have... no memories...

units.rawText: Shield... and chocolate...
units.displayText: Shield... and chocolate...

spans.text: Shield... and chocolate...

units.rawText: Block explosion... memories... incomplete... eating chocolate... remember everything...
units.displayText: Block explosion... memories... incomplete... eating chocolate... remember everything...

spans.text: Block explosion... memories... incomplete... eating chocolate... remember everything...

units.rawText: Chocolate... Choco specially... made to... prevent... losing memories...
units.displayText: Chocolate... Choco specially... made to... prevent... losing memories...

spans.text: Chocolate... Choco specially... made to... prevent... losing memories...

units.rawText: Choco's here too?!
units.displayText: Choco's here too?!

spans.text: Choco's here too?!

units.rawText: Alright, Persicaria, we can save the detailed questions for later. Zion's language center hasn't been fixed yet and the next explosion will probably arrive before we finish asking her everything. What we need to do right now is fix Reactor No. 1.
units.displayText: Alright, Persicaria, we can save the detailed questions for later. Zion's language center hasn't been fixed yet and the next explosion will probably arrive before we finish asking her everything. What we need to do right now is fix Reactor No. 1.

units.rawText: Persicaria... right!
units.displayText: Persicaria... right!

spans.text: Persicaria... right!

units.rawText: Zion has... lots of data... for Croque... Come with me.
units.displayText: Zion has... lots of data... for Croque... Come with me.

spans.text: Zion has... lots of data... for Croque... Come with me.

units.rawText: Professor... Do you think it's time for some stirring last words... I mean, it's all about to explode anyway...
units.displayText: Professor... Do you think it's time for some stirring last words... I mean, it's all about to explode anyway...
